scope: Dense mechanism diagnostic; fixed-rank generalized Nyström factor, not actual-column exchange or production timing

protocol.update_probe: just-used FCG1 direction p and cached Kp=Ap-lambda*p
protocol.target: best rank-k factor of [Fold,u], same material trace-increase gate as compress_probe
protocol.recurrence: FCG1 with two-pass A orthogonalization; freeze after10; restart controls explicitly named
protocol.extra_control: undamped freeze10 with matched restart to separate damping from restart effects
